_doc: Source trust for catalog_match.score, keyed on the PAGE domain (sub-domains match). Order of trust: brand official (per SKU, from the Brands Mapping sheet) > uae_retailers > structured > other_retail > generic. stock_or_clipart domains (page or image host) and keywords are hard rejects. uae_retailer_image_hosts are the image CDNs the uae_retailers' own product pages use (Lulu, Carrefour UAE, Spinneys, talabat; from the live runs' candidates; only the store's own tenant of a shared CDN, never all of akinoncloudcdn.com or azureedge.net): fetch.HostBreaker treats them as UAE retailer hosts (never skipped as slow), they give NO source trust (that stays keyed on the page domain). retailer_names are store names that appear in listing titles ('... - Shop on Carrefour UAE'); a title segment made only of a retailer name and site_filler words is dropped before brand matching, so a private-label SKU (brand 'Carrefour') never matches another brand's listing through the store name. demoted are stores whose pictures and pages are often poor or wrong (unioncoop.ae): they keep their place in the lists above for search and fetching, but their pages get the LOWEST source trust, below generic sites ('demoted', score.source_trust), so they never make tier 1 and rank last among equals: used only when nothing better exists. company_suffixes are the words a company's own name adds to its brand ('Mehran Foods', 'Marmum Dairy Farm L.L.C'): on the brand's official site a title whose only brand is the site's own name segment keeps tier 1 when that segment is the brand plus such words and the product part does not open with another brand-like word; a place ('Mehran Foods Korea') or another brand in the brand position ('Buy DAWN BREAD ...') caps it (score.py, site_name_brand).
